title: U-Net

paper.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement U-Net: segment generated geometric shapes with aligned encoder-decoder skip features and report intersection over union. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use generated-shapes; required output: [N,C,H,W] -> [N,K,H,W] mask logits. Evaluate iou (maximize). Nearest-neighbor target resize; exact spatial skip alignment. Required ablation: Remove skip concatenations at matched decoder capacity. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
